Create Account Screen

_As a Mapper Customer, I want to create an account so that I can log into the platform._

Features/Acceptance Criteria:

First name entry field (add up to 50 characters)

Last name entry field (add up to 100 characters)

Email entry field (add up to 64 characters in local, add up to 255 in domain)

Industry (add up to 100 characters)

Rob Role (add up to 100 characters)

Password entry field (requires minimum of 8 characters, 1 capital letter, and contains 1 number and 1 symbol)

Required fields asterisks (appears when the user fails to enter any of the above fields)

Create Account Button (processes the create account form)

Sign In Button (takes them to the sign in page)
